title: PVH reimagines the future of fashion with OpenAI
summary: PVH Corp., parent company of Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger, is adopting ChatGPT Enterprise to bring AI into fashion design, supply chain, and consumer engagement.
body: PVH Corp., parent company of Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger, is adopting ChatGPT Enterprise to bring AI into fashion design, supply chain, and consumer engagement.
summaryZh: PVH Corp.宣布全面引入ChatGPT Enterprise，将其深度整合至服装设计、供应链管理及消费者互动等业务环节，推动时尚产业的智能化转型。原始信息显示：PVH Corp., parent company of Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger, is adopting ChatGPT Enterprise to bring AI into fashion design, supply chain, and consumer engagement.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“PVH reimagines the future of fashion with OpenAI”。其重要性主要体现在：知名服装集团PVH全面采用ChatGPT企业版以改造时尚设计与供应链，体现了生成式AI在服装零售业的深度落地。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
